resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]List Functions[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Python has a bunch of useful built-in functions. Like [b]len[/b]!

[b]len [/b]lets you get the number of items in a list. Like this:[code format="py" codeId="3938"]nums = [1, 3, 5, 2, 4]
print([b]len[/b](nums))[/code]
[b][/b]You can also use [b]len [/b]on strings to return their length (character count).
[note]Unlike indexing items, [b]len[/b] does not start with 0. The list above contains 5 items, meaning len will return 5.[/note]

resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Useful Functions[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Time for the lightning round! Let’s do a quick rundown of the functions supported by lists.[code format="py" codeId="3098"]nums = [1, 2, 3]
nums.append(4)
print(nums)  [/code]
[note]Note, that the function is called using the list name, followed by a dot.[/note]
[b]insert()[/b] - inserts a new item at any position in the list:[code format="py" codeId="3099"]words = ["Python", "fun"]
index = 1
words.insert(index, "is")
print(words) [/code]
[b]index()[/b] - finds the first occurrence of a list item and returns its index.[code format="py" codeId="3100"]letters = ['p', 'q', 'r', 's', 'p', 'u']
print(letters.index('r'))
print(letters.index('p'))
print(letters.index('q')) [/code]
[b]max[/b](list): Returns the maximum value.
[b]min[/b](list): Returns the minimum value.
list.[b]count[/b](item): Returns a count of how many times an item occurs in a list.
list.[b]remove[/b](item): Removes an item from a list.
list.[b]reverse[/b](): Reverses items in a list.
[note]For example, you can count how many 42s are there in the list using:
[b]items.count(42)[/b] where [b]items [/b]is the name of our list.[/note]

resolved.title: 去除离群值
resolved.problem_statement_md:
假设你正在分析一个数据集，需要去除离群值（最小和最大的值）

完善代码：从列表中删除最小和最大的元素，并输出剩余数字的总和。

如果最小值或最大值是重复的，则**仅去除一个**。
比如`[1,1,2,3,3]` 去除最大值、最小值为 `[1,2,3]`。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]List Functions[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You’re analyzing a data set and need to remove the outliers (the smallest and largest values.
The data is stored in a list). 

Complete the code to remove the smallest and largest elements from the list and output the sum of the remaining numbers.
[note]Remember the functions a list supports: [b]min[/b] and [b]max[/b] can be used to get the smallest and largest numbers.[/note]
resolved.hint_md: 记住列表支持的功能。可以用 **min** 和 **max** 来获得最小和最大的数字。
